items.title: Beta 0.4.1 — captures you can edit
items.body: Screenshots are now saved as files every time (and copied), and recording works with the system's screen picker. Library → Captures shows all of them: open a screenshot to draw on it again, or a video to trim it, change its speed, drop the sound or save a frame.

items.title: Pick how lively it is
items.body: Settings → Personalise → Animations: Calm, Balanced (new default) or Lively.

items.title: Updates are required
items.body: When a new version is out, the island asks you to update before you continue. It takes a minute and restarts by itself.
